LESSON: INTERPRETING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1.3: Interpreting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Interpreting
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Interpreting
2. give Kenyan examples of Interpreting
3. practise a safe skill for Interpreting

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Interpreting

Teach
• Observe Interpreting in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Interpreting (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Interpreting.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Interpreting.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Interpreting.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Interpreting.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Interpreting: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Interpreting with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
